Good news: [URL_021] is online again. I restored the DNS records, and the site is serving normally now.

There is one remaining issue with [URL_026]. Its DNS correctly points to Firebase, but the domain was removed from the Firebase Hosting configuration, which is why it displays a "Site Not Found" page. Since I don't have Firebase access, I can't add it back myself, but you can quickly fix it from your side:

1\. Open the LotClip project at [URL_027]
2\. Click Hosting in the left menu
3\. Locate the lotclip-main site, then click "Add custom domain"
4\. Enter [URL_026]
5\. Select the option to redirect it to an existing site, then choose [URL_021]
6\. Continue through the remaining steps to finish. The requested DNS records are already set up, so you only need to confirm them

Afterward, the SSL certificate will take a few hours to be issued, so www might display a warning until that process finishes. No other changes are required.
